with **destinationPaymentMethod** (see `RaaSPartnerPaymentMethod`).

destinationPaymentMethod.description: Destination rail (card, UBN, etc.); discriminated by `type`.

correlationId.description: Partner-supplied idempotency key; must be unused and is returned as `operationId` on success.

request.description: Correlation id, beneficiary, amounts, optional reason, and payout method. Processed asynchronously after HTTP 200.

Incluido en OpenAPI para que los clientes generen tipos/enums.

RequestMoneyFullOutcomePayload.description:
Payload enviado al webhook del tenant cuando el worker de request-money-full
termina (éxito o fallo). Permite a la integración reaccionar a fallos async (CIP, tarjeta, etc.).

errorCode.description: Solo cuando status === 'failed'. Código estable para la integración.

phase.description: Fase donde falló. Solo cuando status === 'failed'.

sendTo.description: Recipient phone (normalized by controller per tenant rules).

SendMoneyParams.description: Send-money payload with `sendTo` as a normalized phone string.

quotationId.description: required Executable quotation id from the quote endpoint.

reason.description: Memo or description shown on the operation.

destinationPaymentMethodId.description: Destination PM id when not implied by the quote.

sourcePaymentMethodId.description: Source PM id on file for the sender when not implied by the quote.

SendMoneyPartnerParams.description:
Partner **send funds** body (`send-funds/{userToken}`): executes a locked `quotationId` for the path user.
`sendTo` may be omitted when the quotation embeds the destination.

SendMoneyPartnerV2Params.description: Partner **send funds v2** body: like `SendMoneyPartnerParams` but may include structured `sendTo` / destination PM.

destinationPaymentMethod.description: Destination payment method object or processor-specific shape.

ReceiveMoneyParams.description: Partner **receive / accept incoming funds** stub (destination instrument and correlation).

QuoteTransactionBase.description: Full quote request used by internal quote services (rich corridor + PM payload).

QuoteTransactionPartnersBase.description:
Partner-focused quote request: recipient id, amounts, and optional PM ids/objects.
Used when building quotations from the partner API without the full internal shape.

PartnerPreQuoteRequest.description: Minimal **pre-quote** body for some partner full flows (destination PM + amount).

cancelable.description: Indicates if the operation can be cancelled by the funder user.

ignoredData.description: Data about the reason why the operation was ignored by the funder user.

isIgnored.description: Indicates if the operation was ignored by the funder user.

recipientCurrency.description:
Recipient currency code

ISO 4217 format.
Example: `USD` for United States Dollar, `MXN` for Mexican Peso.

senderCurrency.description:
Sender currency code

ISO 4217 format.
Example: `USD` for United States Dollar, `MXN` for Mexican Peso.

currency.description:
Currency code

ISO 4217 format.
Example: `USD` for United States Dollar, `MXN` for Mexican Peso.

code.description:
User frendly operation code for support purposes

Example: `ABC123`.

reason.description:
Reason. Free text.

Example: `Hi! I need money`.

correlationId.description:
Correlation ID

Partner provided operation identifier.

id.description:
Correlation ID

Partner provided operation identifier.

ReplaceCardParams.description: Partner body to **replace** an existing card PM with a new tokenized instrument.

paymentMethodId.description: Existing payment method id to replace.

opPlatId.description: Platform operation id tying the replace to a quotation or order when required.

SetPaymentMethodParams.description: Partner body to set the **default** (primary) payment method for payouts or sends.

paymentMethodId.description: Payment method id to promote as primary.

opPlatId.description: Platform operation id when the change is scoped to an in-flight operation.

AcceptOrRejectFundsRequest.description: Partner accept/reject of a pending inbound transfer (phones or emails identify parties).

DraftRequestMoney.description: Draft “request money” payload used in partner draft-save flows before confirmation.

QuoteLiteTransaction.description: **Lite** quote request for partner `quotation-lite`-style routes: countries, method types, and amounts only.

ExchangeRate.description: **Exchange rate** rows for partner rates endpoints and quotation services.

isMostFrequent.description: This config is to display the most frequent quick amount in the UI

ShortLinkRequest.description: Partner service body: long URL to shorten for SMS or deep links.

link.description: Absolute HTTPS URL to shorten. Example: `https://app.example.com/path?x=1`.

shortUrl.description: Shortened URL returned by the link service.

CIPWebRequest.description: Partner service body: CIP **web session** token to resolve into a hosted URL.

token.description: Opaque CIP session token issued by the CIP widget or prior step.

link.description: HTTPS URL to open the CIP web flow.

urlProfile.description: This field is to return the profile photo in runtime. It is not saving in db.

userId.description: This field is to return the userId photo in runtime. It is not saving in db.

UserExtendDataInfo.description: Extended debug snapshot for a user in test-helper responses.

userToken.description: Resolved user id / token for the row.

TestHelperParams.description: Non-production **test helper** body to seed users/contacts between two phones.

autoCreateContact.description: When true, creates an address-book contact from sender → destination if missing.

UserUpdateParams.description:
Partial profile update payload for **partner** `PUT /user/profile/{phoneOrEmail}` and related flows.
All fields are optional unless the route applies additional validation; only send fields that change.

email.description: Email address. Duplicates may be rejected per tenant policy. Example: `user@example.com`.

secondLastName.description: Second last name (e.g. maternal) when collected.

address1.description: Primary address line (street and number). Example: `Av. Reforma 222`.

placeId.description: Google Places or internal place identifier when available.

country.description: Country name or label as stored for the profile (not necessarily ISO code).

gender.description: Self-reported gender when the product collects it.

dob.description:
Date of birth. **ISO 8601** date or date-time.
When validated, typically must represent age **18–100** years unless product rules differ.

status.description: Account lifecycle status for the user record.

customCountryCode.description: Custom country code field when used by tenant-specific flows.

state.description:
State / province / department.
Prefer **ISO 3166-2** where available (e.g. `MX-JAL`).

birthState.description:
State or region of birth when collected for compliance.
**ISO 3166-2** or short name per product rules.

tAndCAccepted.description: Terms and conditions acceptance flag when updated via API.

callLocationLatitude.description: Latitude from **device / session** location when available.

callLocationLongitude.description: Longitude from **device / session** location when available.

Pick_ValidatePINCodeParams.Exclude_keyof.description: From T, pick a set of properties whose keys are in the union K

Omit_ValidatePINCodeParams.deviceId_.description: Construct a type with the properties of T except for those in type K.

ValidatePINCodeParamsPartner.description: Partner validate-PIN: same as `ValidatePINCodeParams` without `deviceId` (not used on partner route).

SetPincodeParams.description:
PIN lifecycle payloads for **partner** `userController` (`set-pincode`, `validate-pincode`).
PIN values are hashed server-side; never log raw pins.

pincode.description: required Numeric PIN per product rules (length validated server-side).

SetPincodeParamsPartner.description: Partner set-PIN body: may include `phone` or `email` when not implied by the path.
